commonFormula.chance: Most W_SK: nextInt(1000) in 0..999 <= random1 + max(0,enchant)*random2; setters cap random1/2 individually at1000; therefore threshold0 still1/1000. W_SK0017..23 use nextInt(1000)+1 <= threshold. Custom W_SK0016/20/21/024 have own enchant branch: use methods.
commonFormula.dmg3: Java integer mean of selected STR/DEX/INT/WIS/CHA/CON then arithmetic shift >>1
commonFormula.calc_dmg4: IMMUNE_TO_HARM => src/2; ac_mr1 subtract AC reduction;2 MR4;3 subtract AC then MR4; attr sign*int(.16*abs(resist))/32.0; return src*(1-attrFactor)*(level/100)
commonFormula.WARNING: Three-param calc_dmg is DIFFERENT older overload: 0.32 resistance with integer shift, MR table and ac_mr3 overwrite. Do not substitute.

nullPowerBehavior: 175 has no definition. load2 appends null to list; uniformly choosing null causes return0. Other entries remain available.
fallback: L1AttackPc.weaponSkill calls WeaponSkillStart first. Only nonzero returned damage stops fallback. Zero returns from active side effects still continue legacy weapon-specific switch or weapon_skill table.
